hints.title: Block Statement Delimiter Missing
hints.question: In Python syntax, which character is mandatory at the end of a header line to begin an indented block?
hints.conceptHint: Compound statements like if, for, while, and def must always terminate with a colon (:).

hints.title: Divisor Search Range Optimization
hints.question: Your logic is functional, but do we truly need to test divisors all the way up to n - 1? What is the theoretical upper bound for the smallest non-trivial divisor of n?
hints.conceptHint: Non-trivial factors always appear in complementary pairs and never exceed the square root of n (int(n**0.5) + 1).
